author: FrostedCupcakez
body:
Hello ^-^

Rather than posting a thread for every single video I upload to my channel, this will now be my video hub!
If you enjoy the videos I post, make sure you hit the thumbs up and subscribe to my channel!

  • Berzerk Series #1 | Scrim Practice 08/17/15: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BbWvIaOxPhQ
  • Badlion Series #1 | The Dream Team: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=624QMWTVacM
  • Berzerk Series #2 | Berzerk vs Cacalmarin: https://youtu.be/3Xx5Zjp0eBk
  • Mineplex Series #1 | The Bridges ft. Hete: https://youtu.be/rAD3zMHjevk
  • The Avicus Network: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wknZKYe-Cfg
  • Mineplex Series #2 | SG & Bridges Highlights ft. Hete ^-^: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5ELIcxZpnD0
  • Hypixel Series #1 | Skywars Highlights ft. FutbolHunter: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UjY2F2gPovg

If you have any suggestions for videos, feel free to message me on Skype!
Thanks guys!
